title: Accounting and Finance Solution Island
author: Matthew Johnson and David Marlatt
description:
The white sands surround you as you open your eyes to bright sunshine. You are drenched in sea water and your clothes are torn and ragged. To the North in the water is The Oracle Kraken destroying a ship by snapping it in half. In the distance on a hill you see a castle.

An old Flintwood Pistol lays in the shimmering sand in front of you.

Sparkles shimmer off the sand. Reflecting the beating sun.
